notes.title: Sleeping Dawn VR: release date
notes.content:
Hi all, finally all is ready. 
28 September 2018: save the date. Sleeping Dawn VR is almost here.

The VR Edition is a redesigned experience from the original game. We are happy to announce that everyone who will buy the VR version will receive for FREE the original Sleeping Dawn desktop version.

Check out and enjoy the new multiplayer trailer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kr2zDPpw8uc

notes.title: The dawn is back… and now you can touch it!
notes.content:
Sleeping Dawn VR is finally coming: we are happy to announce that Effimera Studio is hard working on to bring it to you as soon as possible. Multiplayer development is in progress and we can't wait to show you what we have in store!
We are trying to merge again the winning formula of the “funny-suspense” to bring a new sensational experience in virtual reality. 
From the release of Sleeping Dawn many of you have asked for a VR version of the game. Now the time has come: break the fourth wall and grab your fears!
